sources.title: Map of Saskatchewan Showing Completed Watershed Plans
sources.publication_date_note: Printed map production date, not the URL directory date or HTTP modification date.

map_locations.scope: Complete Saskatchewan map and complete selected lake regions near Denare Beach, Cumberland House and Stanley Mission.

sources.short_label_scope: Amisk Lake and Cumberland Lake support the first two target identities. Otter Lake is contextual only for the third target and does not establish its name.
sources.source_limit: One dated regional planning map. The publisher cautions that accuracy, completeness and currency vary. Individual channels, current shorelines and precise naming partitions are not established.

independence_note: The full map and regional views belong to one official publication and count once.
availability_scope_note: The existing acquired original supplies complete map coverage for all three targets. No new request was made. The third target is a completed naming-scope hold, rather than an access-pending record.
included_evidence_limit: Included records retain official bibliography, own factual observations and geometry facts. Source publications and inspection materials are excluded. Public offline validation checks included records and geometry; it does not reproduce visual map judgments.
